## Episode Thesis

The episode covers Klarna's Q2 report. Results beat expectations on growth and profitability, yet the stock fell about 23%, its largest drop since listing, because management lowered its Q3 and full-year guidance for revenue and payment volumes. In an interview, CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski blames FX effects and weak consumer sentiment in Germany. He points to 42% growth in transaction margin dollars, 2 million subscriptions and a raised guidance for contribution margin dollars. The transcript ends before the host answers whether the sell-off was justified, so no explicit directional view is given.
